name: daddylive-stream-resolver
description: Resolve DaddyLive (DLHD) watch pages into direct HLS (.m3u8) and WebM stream URLs. TypeScript scraper fetches player embeds; pure resolver decrypts daddy3, plus, hub, and CDN payloads. Referer-aware proxy for playback, web UI for all seven DLHD players, VLC and MPV export links, and a library API for custom pipelines.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc && mkdir -p dist/web && cp src/web/style.css dist/web/
scripts.start: sh -c 'lsof -ti:${PORT:-3000} | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; npm run build && node dist/server/index.js'
